Large Mixed Lot Natural Rocks Minerals Tumbled Stones Fossils Sea Glass
Large mixed lot of natural rock and mineral specimens including tumbled stones, mineral slices, fossil-like coral and agate slabs with circular patterns, beach-worn pebbles, and polished sea glass pieces in blue, brown, amber, black, and white.
